title: Three Days and One Short Bowl
subtitle: 饮食健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）
meta: 主题语境：饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）　|　核心词汇：tofu　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tofu 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the cook ① made the tofu that no guest in the canteen would have described, and he said the making was the whole of the day. The ② tofu, meaning the curd itself and not the bowl, ran three days and stayed undescribed in the book; tofu, he said, is the only thing in a canteen that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ spoonful of tofu in that canteen had the same short bowl beside it, and the ④ tofu at the far table, meaning the portion they kept for the children to share and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Tofu, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the cook said the describing is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the tofu was the whole of the matter, meaning the plainness and not the curd. The ⑥ tofu, meaning the plainness and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; tofu, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both curd and a plainness. He said the plainness is the part they remember.

By 1991 the ⑦ tofu had become a line in a menu, and the menu had become an argument about the short bowl. The ⑧ tofu of the whole thing, the cook wrote in September, was one canteen and three days of describing; tofu, he said, is either the portion at the far table or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ tofu I remember is the tofu described in the menu, which closed in 1993 and is still described as the quietest in the canteen. ⑩ Tofu, my mother said in 1995, is the only thing that improves by being described; all tofu, she said, is a plainness that has agreed to look like curd. She said the plainness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 豆腐（指食堂里每一勺旁边的那一勺）
B. n. 豆腐（指那块豆腐本身，与小小的碗相对）
C. 固定搭配：make the tofu 做这一块豆腐
D. n. 豆腐（指留给孩子们分着吃的那一份）
E. n. 豆腐之事（抽象总称，指一处食堂的豆腐之事）
F. n. 豆腐（指菜单里写到、被描述的那一块）
G. n. 豆腐、清淡（指一件事里人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 清淡（抽象总称，指人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: made the tofu that no guest in the canteen would have described
The tofu, meaning the curd itself and not the bowl
Every spoonful of tofu in that canteen
the tofu at the far table
the tofu was the whole of the matter
the tofu had become a line in a menu
The tofu of the whole thing

answers.why: make the tofu 意为“做这一块豆腐”，1986 年那位厨子把食堂里没有一位客人肯描述的一块豆腐做了一遍。
tofu 意为“豆腐”，指那块豆腐本身而不是小小的碗，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被描述。
tofu 意为“豆腐”，指食堂里每一勺旁边的那一勺，每一勺旁边都有同一只小小的碗。
tofu 意为“豆腐”，指最远那张桌角的留给孩子们分着吃的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
tofu 意为“豆腐、清淡”，指一件事里人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这块清淡就是那件事的全部。
tofu 意为“清淡”，指人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西而不是那块豆腐，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
tofu 意为“豆腐”，指菜单里写到、被描述的那一块，到 1991 年这一块成了菜单里的一行。
tofu 意为“豆腐之事”，厨子九月写道，整件事的豆腐之事是一处食堂和三个日子的描述。
tofu 意为“豆腐”，我记得的是菜单里描述过的那一块，1993 年开完了，至今仍被说成食堂里最安静的一块。
tofu 为抽象总称，母亲 1995 年说，豆腐是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的豆腐。
